The type shows union of string or array? It says add_ons?: "Backstage Pass" | "VIP Seating" | "Parking Pass"[], which is ambiguous. Probably they want add_ons to be a string or array of strings. We'll provide array for multiple add-ons.

So first booking: artist: "Taylor Swift", location: "New York", add_ons: ["VIP Seating"].

2. Concert of Ed Sheeran in Los Angeles with Backstage Pass and Parking Pass add-ons. So add_ons: ["Backstage Pass", "Parking Pass"].

3. Festival of Coachella in Indio with Camping Pass and Parking Pass add-ons. Use festival_book_ticket: festival: "Coachella", location: "Indio", add_ons: ["Camping Pass", "Parking Pass"].
